playstyle: Four duardin warriors sharing identical Move 3, one-shield saves and four health form a compact, resilient battleline that advances as a unit. Fjul-Grimnir extends threat range with a reach weapon while Maegrim's three attack dice deliver reliable pressure. The generic Order warscrolls let the warband choose between pushing deep to seize enemy treasure tokens or anchoring its own territory and denying flanks, inspiring through in-territory aggression. Either way, it wins through positional control and attrition rather than burst damage.
